meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Team-first maximum-saturation research orchestration. ALWAYS asks which final format to render (PDF+DOCX default), then stands up a max-size cooperating team (team_create): one member per axis plus skeptic/red-team members for ultradebate/hyperdebate cross-critique, explore/librarian lanes, live journaling, an EXPAND loop until leads run dry, claims proven by code or the claim-graph gate, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind visual-QA and `writing` proofread gates. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research: the word 'ulw-research' in any prefix form, any 'ulw' research wording including combined invocations like 'mass ulw research', 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 围绕任意选题派出多路研究者交叉辩论，输出带引用与图表的深度报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果一件事需要顶住不同观点，把证据追到源码并整理成正式报告。
copy.tagline_en: Turn any question into a cited, multi-perspective report with charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need well-sourced analysis weighing opposing views, ending in a polished report.

howto.what: 收到“深入研究”类请求后,它先问清交付格式(默认 PDF+DOCX),再组建多角色 AI 团队分工查证,成员互相辩论并用代码验证争议结论,直到线索穷尽,最终产出带引用、图表并通过视觉与文字校对检查的报告。
howto.when: 只有当你明确要求研究时才会触发:提到“ulw-research”、带“ulw”的研究措辞、或要求“深度研究/超辩论”等;普通问答、调试不会启动。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 调研“固态电池量产进展”
say.note: 会先确认格式,再组建团队开工。

say.text: 对这三种电池路线做深度研究,输出 PDF 和 Word
say.note: 建队前先与你确认交付格式。

say.text: mass ulw research:对比三种开源大模型许可协议
say.note: 按大规模模式收集,并由团队辩论交叉验证。

howto.what_en: On research requests, it asks the output format (default PDF+DOCX), builds a multi-role team that debates and verifies claims with code, exhausts leads, and outputs a cited synthesis that passed visual and writing QA.
howto.when_en: Activates only on explicit research requests (e.g., 'ulw-research', 'ulw' wording, 'ultradebate'/'hyperdebate', deep research). Ordinary questions/debugging never trigger it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to investigate solid-state battery production progress.
say_en.note: It will confirm the format first, then form the team.

say_en.text: Do deep research on these three battery routes and output PDF and Word.
say_en.note: It confirms the format before building the team.

say_en.text: Mass ulw research: compare license terms of three open-source LLMs.
say_en.note: Runs mass-scale collection with debate cross-critique.
